name: Buj
description_en:
Buj is an objective-oriented collaboration workspace organized around posts rather than an unstructured stream of messages. An event, task, document or other item can hold status, actions and several conversations, with a personalized feed directing attention to selected work.

Its official material also describes remote conversations, webhook integrations and a Focus Score based on activity linked to objectives. Those are documented product mechanisms, not evidence of increased revenue or validated employee performance. Public materials remain accessible, but several policy pages date to 2019 and operational account behavior has not been tested.
description_zh:
Buj 是面向目标的协作工作区，以帖子而非无结构消息流组织工作。事件、任务、文档等条目可承载状态、动作及多段对话，个性化信息流把注意力引向选定工作。

官方资料还描述远程沟通、Webhook 集成及基于目标关联活动的 Focus Score。这些是文档化产品机制，不是收入增长或员工绩效有效性的证据。公开资料仍可读取，但若干政策页日期为 2019 年，账户运行行为未实测。

core_features.explanation_en: Keep a shared work item and separate conversations for selected people or teams.
core_features.explanation_zh: 保留共同工作条目，并为选定人员或团队建立分开的对话。

core_features.explanation_en: Focus Score reflects activity on posts linked to objectives; formula is not fully disclosed.
core_features.explanation_zh: Focus Score 反映目标关联帖子的活动，完整公式未公开。

core_features.explanation_en: Surface external events and connect them to discussions and actions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把外部事件呈现到讨论与动作的上下文中。

en: Evaluate one release/incident post with separate participant conversations and an external event source.
zh: 用一个发布／事件帖子、分开参与者的对话及外部事件源进行评估。
use_cases.basis: Original evaluation scenario; no customer case or workflow execution.

steps.en: Compare source event, post state, follow-up and exit copy before connecting live work.
steps.zh: 接入真实工作前，比较源事件、帖子状态、跟进及退出副本。

review_notes: English and Chinese were checked against the sources attached to each section. Editorial examples and selection judgments are not customer evidence.
Read_at is retrieval time; public-reader text may be cached and does not establish vendor update time.

sections.title_en: Keep the work item stable while conversations differ
sections.title_zh: 工作条目保持一致，对话分别展开
sections.en:
For a proposed release investigation, create one post for the event, attach the relevant context and use separate conversations for engineering and customer communication. The post provides a common reference while the documented conversation audience is limited to participating people or teams.

That does not establish that every post field, attachment or subsequent share has the same visibility. Before using confidential material, test the intended participants and a nonparticipant against a harmless post. Buj’s model can reduce context fragmentation only when the team agrees on which post represents the work; no such workspace test was performed here.
sections.zh:
假设调查发布问题，可为事件建立一个帖子，附上相关上下文，再分别展开工程和客户沟通对话。帖子提供共同参照，文档规定对话受众限于参与人员或团队。

这不证明所有帖子字段、附件及后续分享都具有相同可见性。使用保密材料前，应以无害帖子核对目标参与者和未参与者。只有团队约定哪个帖子代表工作时，该模型才可能减少上下文割裂；本研究没有执行工作区测试。

sections.title_en: Read Focus Score as activity alignment, not delivered value
sections.title_zh: 把 Focus Score 读作活动关联，不当作交付价值
sections.en:
The dated Focus Score article describes an increase as a user acts on posts linked to objectives. Listed inputs include reading, posting, reacting, commenting, setting status and tagging. The full calculation is not disclosed.

This can help a team inspect where attention goes, but it does not establish output quality, effort, useful completion or a fair comparison between people. In a proposed review, pair a relevant post with its actual deliverable and acceptance condition. A high activity-derived score should not substitute for checking whether the objective was achieved.
sections.zh:
有日期的 Focus Score 文章描述，用户在目标关联帖子上活动时分数会上升；列举输入包括阅读、发帖、反应、评论、设状态及标签，完整算法未公开。

它可辅助查看注意力去向，但不证明产出质量、投入、有效完成或人员间公平比较。假设做复核，应把相关帖子与真实交付物和验收条件配对。较高的活动分数不能替代目标是否达成的检查。

sections.title_en: An incoming event is not a guaranteed two-way workflow
sections.title_zh: 收到事件不等于保证双向流程
sections.en:
The integration page describes surfacing Jira, GitHub/GitLab and Jenkins events through a webhook interface. Jira descriptions include updates and edits from Buj; GitHub wording explicitly invites building custom two-way integrations. Those claims have different implementation scope.

For a proposed failed-build notification, agree on the external event identity, target post, recipient and which action may write back. Check source state after any action rather than assuming a message changed the source system. Authentication setup, payload schemas, deduplication, rate limits and failed-delivery replay were not established by the public overview.
sections.zh:
集成页描述经 Webhook 呈现 Jira、GitHub／GitLab 及 Jenkins 事件；Jira 说明包括更新和从 Buj 编辑，GitHub 文字则明确要求构建自定义双向集成，两者实现范围不同。

假设接收构建失败通知，应约定外部事件标识、目标帖子、接收者及哪些动作允许回写。动作后需核对源状态，不应认为消息自动改变源系统。公开概览未确立认证配置、载荷结构、去重、速率限制及失败送达重放。

sections.title_en: Calls can leave a follow-up post
sections.title_zh: 通话可以留下跟进帖子
sections.en:
Buj’s remote-team page describes a virtual desk that teammates can approach, persistent team meeting rooms and screen recording with commentary. It says audio/video calls create a post for notes, action items and follow-up.

For a proposed QA discussion, use the recording to explain the observed behavior, then give an action item a responsible person and clear completion evidence. A call-generated post is not a verified transcript, an automatically assigned task or proof of consent to recording. Client support, recording retention, participant permissions and the current reliability of those paths remain untested.
sections.zh:
Buj 远程团队页描述成员可接近的虚拟办公桌、持续团队会议室及带解说的屏幕录制，并称音视频通话会建立帖子，用于笔记、行动项及跟进。

假设讨论 QA 问题，可用录制解释观察到的行为，再给行动项指定负责人和明确完成证据。通话生成帖子不等于经验证转录、自动分配任务或录制同意证明。客户端支持、录制保留、参与权限及当前可靠性均未实测。

sections.title_en: Free access has history and integration limits
sections.title_zh: 免费访问有历史及集成限制
sections.en:
The official homepage offers Free for an unlimited period, but limits visible recent messages to 10,000, app integrations to ten and progress charts to the last ten tasks. One-to-one calling is included. Standard requests a quote and describes broader history/integration access and group calling; Enterprise also requests pricing and advertises organizational controls, exports and own-VPC operation.

A visible page is not proof that a new paid workspace can be provisioned today. Obtain the applicable quote and service conditions before budgeting for a team. Numeric paid prices, billing cadence, cancellation/refund rules, over-limit behavior and current enrollment were not verified; free-period wording should not be expanded into unlimited message history.
sections.zh:
官方首页提供不限时长的 Free，但最近消息可见范围为 10,000 条、应用集成十个、进度图限最近十个任务，并包含一对一通话。Standard 要求询价，描述更广历史／集成及群组通话；Enterprise 同样询价，宣传组织控制、导出及自有 VPC 运行。

页面可见不证明今天能开通新付费工作区。团队预算前需取得适用报价及服务条件；准确付费价格、账期、取消／退款、超限行为及当前注册未核实。不限免费时长不能扩写成无限消息历史。

sections.title_en: Workspace administration governs access and retained data
sections.title_zh: 工作区管理影响访问及数据保留
sections.en:
User terms distinguish the Customer controlling a workspace from its authorized users. The privacy policy describes customer-directed data handling and activity metadata, with retention dependent on the customer agreement, instructions and legal requirements. Conversation privacy therefore should not be interpreted as absence of workplace administration or usage records.

The 2019 security overview asserts encrypted storage and vendor backup/recovery measures. It supplies neither a demonstrated user export/restore procedure nor verified recovery targets. A migration evaluation should include an independently inspected exit copy and the current agreement. Own-VPC advertising does not grant a reusable source-code license; no open-source or supported self-installation rights were established.
sections.zh:
用户条款区分控制工作区的 Customer 与获授权用户。隐私政策描述按客户指令处理数据及记录活动元数据，保留取决于客户协议、指令和法定要求。因此，对话私密不能解释为不存在工作区管理或使用记录。

2019 年安全概览宣称存储加密及厂商备份／恢复措施，但未提供经演示的用户导出／恢复流程或核实的恢复目标。迁移评估应包含单独检查的退出副本及现行协议。自有 VPC 宣传不授予可复用源码许可，未确立开源或受支持的自行安装权利。

seo.title_en: Buj: Objective-Linked Posts, Focus Score and Collaboration Limits
seo.title_zh: Buj：目标关联帖子、Focus Score 与协作限制
seo.description_en: Examine post audiences, webhook actions, call follow-ups and free-history limits without adopting performance or uptime claims as tested facts.
seo.description_zh: 核对帖子受众、Webhook 动作、通话跟进及免费历史限制，不把绩效或可用率宣传当作实测事实。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate post-centered collaboration linked to objectives.
secondary_questions: Does free access include complete message history?
seo.query_basis: Editorial hypotheses; no measured demand or ranking.
